g.text: Ablated speedup / complete speedup; 100% = no change
100% means no change; lower values indicate stronger dependence; above 100% means the fallback was faster.
Dashed line: 13-Shape geometric mean (14.49x). * dependency closure; + QKV-side partial.
CAP = unsafe full-batch counterfactual; CPL = active but coupled; N/A = already on fallback.
Each cell is the fraction of complete speedup retained after replacing one mechanism family with its legal fallback
Full gains and performance retained after mechanism removal
